subset: all 50000 examples in canonical batch order
fft: numpy rfft2 norm=ortho with exact Parseval half-plane weights
radial_bin: floor(sqrt(fx^2 + fy^2) + 1e-12) in unshifted integer-frequency coordinates
channel_aggregation: mean over images, RGB channels, and full-plane sites in each shell
selection: Use 50K spectrum by preregistered rule; 1K and 50K frontier estimates are nevertheless highly stable.
selection_trigger: maximum absolute shell-relative difference 0.08923923769393464 at r=22 exceeded 0.05
sensitivity_caveat: r=22 contains one full-plane coefficient per channel; all other shells changed by less than 0.05, only 19/1000 DDPM timesteps changed R_MI, the maximum R_MI shift was one shell, and 0/20 E006-grid crossings changed
role: selected dataset-level spectrum for the moving and static spectral intervention
